Strategic Advantage • Merchant Exporter Ecosystem

The Great Indian Trade Alliance Advantage

Section 01 / Leadership & Sourcing
Great Indian Trade Alliance (GITA) operates as a specialized merchant export powerhouse headquartered in New Delhi with field desks across Haryana, Punjab, and Gujarat. While single-location millers are inherently vulnerable to harvest crop failures, machine downtime, and localized price spikes, GITA commands an agile multi-origin merchant model. We aggregate milling across certified Bühler Sortex partner facilities, enforced by our own on-ground grain inspectors, dedicated customs brokerage, and direct ocean carrier booking.

Institutional Merchant Exporter Infrastructure
01 Specialist On-Ground Verification

Full-time verification officers inspect raw paddy and milled lots at origin. We test Average Grain Length (AGL), cooking elongation ratio (≥2.0x), moisture (<12.5%), and purity before approving bagging.

02 Bühler Sortex Processing Network

Processing through strategic milling partners equipped with multi-stage German Bühler and Japanese Satake optical color sorters, eradicating chalky, discolored, or immature grains at micro-second speeds.

03 In-House Maritime Freight Contracts

Direct carrier volume contracts with tier-1 shipping lines eliminate forwarder markups, secure guaranteed container allocation during peak shipping seasons, and deliver ultra-competitive landed CFR/CIF rates.

04 Port Stuffing & Customs Supervision

In-house port teams stationed at Mundra, Nhava Sheva (JNPT), and Kandla supervise 100% dry-liner container preparation, install industrial silica desiccants, conduct tare checks, and execute customs clearance.
